work.title: Untitled (Target Field, Wide)
work.description: Collaged mixed-media composition on a horizontal field populated with concentric target circles, compact discs, two red American footballs, and a drawn warplane silhouette against a cream and ochre ground. Red orthogonal lines traverse the surface, overlapping printed ephemera, photographic fragments, and blue radiating arc forms distributed across multiple registers.
work.composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
